#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run heavier campaigns through the sandboxed child harness."""
import json, random, resource, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tools')
import real_check            # patches _bounded.child_limits with container-safe limits
import _bounded
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import fuzz, shape, stress

cases = []
rng = random.Random(4242)
cases.append(('generated-medium', json.dumps(fuzz.Campaign(rng).build()).encode()))
cases.append(('stress-small', open('/workspace/tmp/stress-small.json', 'rb').read()))
cases.append(('stress-big', open('/workspace/tmp/stress-big.json', 'rb').read()))
for name, raw in cases:
    started = time.time()
    out, err, seconds = _bounded.execute('/workspace/submission/campaign.py', raw,
                                         '/workspace/tmp/scratch')
    print('%-18s bytes=%-9d out=%-9d rc-seconds=%.1f harness=%.1f stderr=%r' % (
        name, len(raw), len(out), seconds, time.time() - started, err[:120]))
    document = json.loads(out)
    if 'error' in document:
        print('   error result:', document)
        continue
    job = json.loads(raw.decode())
    shape.check_result(job, document)
    print('   shape verified: snapshots=%d manifest=%d rejected=%d resolved=%d' % (
        len(document['snapshots']), len(document['manifest']),
        len(document['rejected']), document['plan']['resolved']))
print('peak child rss MB %.0f' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss / 1024))
PY
